import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_93/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_93/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_93_1 and Source3_93_2 on 'movie_id'
joined = pd.merge(source1, source2, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Group by movie_id and count user_id occurrences (count of ratings per movie)
agg = joined.groupby("movie_id", as_index=False).agg({"user_id": "count"})

# Rename columns to match target schema ['movie_id', '0']
agg.rename(columns={"user_id": "0"}, inplace=True)

# Ensure column types match target schema: movie_id int, 0 int
agg["movie_id"] = agg["movie_id"].astype(int)
agg["0"] = agg["0"].astype(int)

# Save the result to the target path
agg.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_93/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
